name: inkmark
description: Read, reply to, resolve, and propose edits to inkmark review comments stored inline in a Markdown file as CriticMarkup marks plus a trailing YAML endmatter block. Use whenever a .md file contains {==...==}, {>>...<<}, {++...++}, {--...--}, {~~...~~} marks or a `comments:`/`suggestions:` endmatter block, or when asked to review a Markdown draft, check unresolved comments, reply to feedback, or open a document in inkmark.

interface.shortDescription: Inline review comments in a Markdown file, readable by the agent
interface.longDescription: inkmark keeps review comments and suggested edits inside the Markdown file itself — CriticMarkup marks in the body plus a YAML endmatter block — so an agent can read a draft's open threads, reply, resolve, and propose edits by editing the same file.
defaultPrompt: Review this Markdown draft with inkmark.
Reply to the open comments in draft.md.
